description: SHT40 digital humidity and temperature sensor, I2C (address 0x44), 1.08-3.6 V, ±1.8 %RH / ±0.2 °C, DFN-4 1.5 x 1.5 mm

datasheet.revision: SHT4x datasheet (version 1, October 2020): 5.2 package outline, 5.3 land pattern, 5.4 pin assignment

package.name: DFN-4 1.5 x 1.5 mm, 0.8 mm pitch

landPattern.page: Figure 10 recommended land pattern: 0.5 x 0.3 mm pads, 1.4 mm apart across (0.2 mm beyond the body), 0.8 mm along; the die pad unsoldered and no copper under the sensor

package.page: Figure 9: 1.5 ± 0.1 mm square, 0.54 ± 0.05 mm high, pads 0.3 x 0.4 mm at 0.8 mm pitch, die pad not connected

parameters.conditions: average current, continuous operation with one measurement per second, high repeatability, no heater, VDD=3.3 V, 25 degC; while a measurement runs the current is 350 uA typ, idle 0.08 uA

source.location: p. 7, section 3.1 Electrical Characteristics, Supply current (no heater)

options.name: pullUps
options.description: The I2C pull-ups (once per bus: `false` when another part of the bus has them).

notes: No copper under the sensor except the four pads; the die pad stays unsoldered (it heats with the heater). Keep it away from hot parts (regulators, the MCU) and give it a slot or cut-out for a true air temperature.
Address 0x44 (SHT40-BD1B: 0x45). A 3.3 V part: on a 5 V bus use a level shifter.
Pull-ups: 10 kΩ in Sensirion's circuit; the bus may share the board's I2C pull-ups (`I2cPullups`).

pins.source: Sensirion SHT4x datasheet: 5.4 pin assignment (1 SDA, 2 SCL, 3 VDD, 4 VSS, transparent top view), 5.2 package outline, 5.3 land pattern, Figure 1 application circuit
